chart.title: Cereal yields
chart.subtitle: Yields are measured in tonnes per hectare. Cereals include wheat, rice, maize, barley, oats, rye, millet, sorghum, buckwheat, and mixed grains.
chart.citation: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025)
